title: Ввести typed trusted-context и binding model в PHP/Dart
summary: Добавить в оба SDK семантически одинаковые immutable types и ports для actor, policy, proposal, approval evidence и context-rich authorization без token wire или storage implementation.
why: Current model различает лишь строковые principal/tool и optional caller booleans; server-selected policy revision, tenant/resource/action context, quorum и exact approval binding нельзя выразить или проверить одинаково в PHP/Dart. `RAG:—`.

include: Authenticated actor; resolved policy with id/revision/commit principal/approval requirement; approval evidence bound to full P2.1 tuple; confirmation record; authorization request and closed decision; provider/registry/resolver/store/read/authorizer ports; invariants, redaction-safe value access and PHP/Dart model parity tests.
exclude: `ConfirmationService`; token parsing/serialization; persistence adapters; network/auth framework integration; event append; package export removal; changing frozen schemas.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Types reject empty identity/version/tenant/action fields, duplicate approver IDs, quorum below one, approver/proposer conflict when forbidden, and any tuple mismatch. Ports expose authoritative reads/decisions, not caller-selected defaults. `ConfirmationRecordStore` and `ApprovalEvidenceReader` are explicitly journal-backed source/projection seams; no second approval truth is created. `AuthorizationRequest` includes subject, tenant, resource, action/tool, environment/risk attributes, proposal/policy/descriptor/args identities and delegation where present. Authorization decision defaults deny and has no boolean constructor that silently means allow. PHP/Dart semantic fields, validation cases and failure classifications match, while class syntax may differ.
guidance: Prefer deep immutable aggregates over bags/maps at the service boundary; framework-specific identities adapt once at `AuthenticatedActorProvider`. Do not put raw tokens, reasons, subject IDs or tenant IDs in exception messages/toString. Keep token codec and existing legacy `Proposal`/`DecisionAudit` wire projection untouched in this item; `ConfirmationRecord` binds them to new hardening context. Test fakes live only in test files.
